source: DICE, bf1942 Kharkov (1.6 patch archives): AI/Strategies.con, AI/conditions.con, AI/prerequisites.con, unchanged
archetype: both sides start with ground of their own (a fixed base or flags each)
note: The side lists are Kharkov's own ai.addSAIStrategy lines, in its order. Stalingrad's set was tried first and dropped: it gates its defensive strategies on a createHomogenousCondition the repo's reader does not parse, so the page's port picks them at the first pass and the side never attacks.
